title: Halt Noble USDC (USDC.n) trading on the BeeZee DEX
summary: Circle is retiring USDC on Noble, and from 2027-01-12 the USDC.n vouchers on BeeZee lose their backing. Since the v8.2.0 upgrade BeeZee no longer accepts new USDC.n deposits from Noble, and the protocol-owned USDC.n/BZE liquidity has been withdrawn to be moved to Injective-issued USDC (USDC.inj). This proposal halts USDC.n (ibc/6490A7EAB61059BFC1CDDEB05917DD70BDF3A611654162A1A47DB930D40D8AF4) on the DEX with the TradeBin halt feature added in v8.2.0. Once halted, USDC.n can no longer be traded: no new orders or fills on its order books, no swaps, no new markets, pools or liquidity, and it can no longer pay transaction fees. Every exit stays open: you can still cancel your resting orders, remove liquidity, send USDC.n and transfer it back to Noble over IBC to redeem it before Circle's deadline. Please move your USDC.n out of BeeZee in time. A later proposal with MsgUnhaltDenoms can lift the halt.
